div.h3: Detailed Component Diagram with Dependencies & Data Flow

div.p: 1. New() Create Application Initialize DI module
2. Initialize() Register services Invoke dependencies Setup commands
3. Validate() Check all commands have handlers Check all flags are bound Run custom hooks
4. Execute() Parse flags Run command Handle errors (fang)
🔴 P0: Broken Hook WithValidationHook accepts but never stores/executes hook
🟡 P1: Missing Context ShutdownWithContext ignores context timeout
🟡 P1: Silent Errors Config loading errors silently ignored
🟢 P2: Error Aggregation Shutdown returns only first error, not all
Levels: debug, info, warn, error Handler: TextHandler → stderr
